description: Look up Docker images in claytono/renovate-docker-datasource, which dates each tag by its Docker Hub push date or by when it was first seen elsewhere

packageRules.description: Look up versioned Docker tags in the image's file. A tag counts when it has a number, optionally after a word such as python or web-v, so that repository versioning rules such as python3.14-trixie-slim work. The nested replaces turn the name as written (nginx, linuxserver/sonarr) into the file's path (docker.io/library/nginx, docker.io/linuxserver/sonarr). The URL is set here rather than as the datasource's default so that it replaces any registry URL a repository sets. Floating tags such as latest or stable stay on the Docker datasource: Renovate updates only their digest, and a custom datasource cannot look up the digest of a tag that is not a version.
